prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one production-ready blank primary button texture for BLACK CROWN fantasy game pack. Create ONE single wide horizontal button, ornate dark royal fantasy craftsmanship, black obsidian face with rich warm antique gold double beveled rim, elegant pointed crown-like filigree only at the far left and right end caps, tiny warm amber inlay accents at the ends. Clearly a premium clickable game button, intricately hand-painted metal with realistic luminous highlights and tactile depth. Straight-on orthographic symmetric view. Very wide 4:1 silhouette, completely visible and centered with 4 percent transparent padding. Keep the central 65 percent an uninterrupted deep dark bronze/black text-safe surface, with faint fine-grain texture and restrained warm edge glow. Strong warm gold border distinguishes this as primary action. No text, letters, numbers, logos, symbols inside the central field, no background, no scene, no characters, no extra buttons. True alpha transparent background outside the ornamental silhouette. Make the end ornaments compact so a two-line Korean label remains fully legible later. This is an actual UI image resource, not a page mockup.
